repeat.scope: Serial processes, one input per process. Public CPU/Metal-auto calls; forced producers mirror the public wrapper. First public CPU/Metal calls are cold controls, then one warmup and rotating-order measured rounds. Encoder timer includes admission, source preparation, selection, features, fitting, tokens, entropy, frame cleanup and output publication. Source IO, domain construction, verification and output IO excluded. Operation timer includes allocation, copy, predictor computation, dispatch, wait and publication; selected channels, backend setup, admission and output destruction outside. Managed peaks exclude borrowed inputs, published output, immutable backend, driver and oracle storage. Active desktop; no concurrent qualification/build/test processes launched here.
